sections.narrative_function: Establish a world waiting for Caspian; ordinary reality before wonder becomes visible.
Reveal the impossible threshold and Caspian as the mystery entering the world.
The stars and hidden worlds respond to Caspian; first exploration of thresholds.
Nature reveals memory: river, moon, trees, impossible things.
Caspian collects wonder objects and prepares to actively follow the hidden map.
Second-chorus adventure: Caspian runs toward the strange and the environment wakes in response.
Years accelerate; possible older selves and accumulating birthdays appear.
Return to the birthday room; candles flicker and spectacle withdraws.
Time stops; the world opens behind reality; all earlier wonders integrate and the silence sings Caspian's name.
Time resumes; Caspian blows out the candles; one impossible point of light remains before black.

directing_rules: Major visual transformations follow phrase/section meaning, not every transient.
Use ~76 BPM half-time weight for primary environmental/body motion; faster subdivisions may animate small details.
Reggae offbeat character can inform sways, light responses, footfall anticipation and spatial echo without becoming a generic visualizer.
Dubstep bass accents may drive localized material pressure, depth and transformation intensity, never whole-frame shake.
